node_geometry_rule: count axes with min distance to opposite faces < delta: 0 bulk-like,1 face-near,2 edge-near,3 corner-near
R1: Full symmetric offset lattice, h^3 neighbor volumes
R2: Retained physical family, diagnostic h^3 neighbor volumes only
K_modifier_primary: physical M3 with K_physical inverse versus analytic continuous K_full inverse; discrete-lattice comparator also reported
Psi_scale: For each field: max analytic physical N19 nodal Psi+; shared by its node and bond diagnostics
energy: U0 actual BAQP; U1 analytic F_mid with original bond weights; U2 continuum 1D Gauss times lateral area; same decomposition for Psi+
depth_bins: half-h centers for bonds; shells with boundaries at +/-h/4 about centers, clipped to [0,L/2]; continuum shell integrals are nested-cube differences
root_cause_logic: User cases A-E and exact causal-chain gates; quote support/volume vector contributions, no extra fitted scientific threshold.
